title: JAVA Fuoco Top 105 | Full Carbon Aero Road Bike

takeaways.text: Arrives very well packed in a roomy box with pedals, reflectors and a manual; assembly is mostly front wheel and seatpost, and the gears came already adjusted.
The new Fuoco Top is full Shimano 105 12-speed including the 165 mm crankset (the previous version used a non-105 crank), with 52/36 and 11–36 gearing and 160/140 mm hydraulic rotors.
Full carbon frame and fork with thru-axles, UCI marking, fully internal routing, aero seatpost and a one-piece Decap carbon bar; sizes 45, 48 and 51.
Stock Michelin Dynamic Sport 28 mm tires on deep Decap carbon wheels with a loud hub; by eye he thinks about 30–32 mm would fit, untested.

disclosure: The presenter runs a shop and points viewers to the Philippine JAVA distributor that supplied the bike; Filipino automatic captions.
summary: A Philippine shop's unboxing and walkaround of the updated JAVA Fuoco Top with full Shimano 105 R7120.
